items.name: Vårkål (Legevårkål samlet her)
items.observations: Original botanical watercolor and colored-pencil illustration showing several shiny golden-yellow flowers with about 8–12 petals and yellow stamens, long stalked glossy green kidney- to heart-shaped leaves, low clustered spring habit, plus fine roots and cream-colored tuberous roots beneath the crown. Reviewed against a fully black background; educational illustration rather than photograph.
items.limitations: Stilized educational botanical depiction rather than a herbarium voucher; flower and leaf variation among subspecies and underground tuber anatomy are simplified. Not a definitive diagnostic key.
